proves.claim: At MERGED_AT_ENGINE merged() records detail.mergedAt as the commit's committer time in ms on the merged event while event_at stays the record time.

store.merged.merged-at-commit-time.why: Without this case the timeline would keep charging landing lag from the record time, so the wait it reports stays wrong.

proves.claim: Below MERGED_AT_ENGINE, or when the caller passes no mergedAt or one that is not a safe integer, the merged event has no mergedAt key.

store.merged.merged-at-absent.why: Without this case an old-engine board or a bad caller value would write a made-up time into a merged event.
